offering_description.value: Develops, manufactures and sells infusion systems for hospitals and other care settings: IV infusion pumps and software, IV solutions, and vascular access and consumable devices. Sells mainly to hospitals, health systems and pharmacies, and makes products in its own plants.

primary_products.value: infusion pumps; IV solutions; IV administration sets and connectors; vascular access devices; pharmacy compounding systems

primary_services.value: infusion pump software and connectivity; pump maintenance and support

customer_segment.value: B2B: hospitals, health systems, alternate care sites, pharmacies, group purchasing organizations; B2G: government and military healthcare facilities

end_markets.value: hospitals and acute care; home and alternate-site infusion; pharmacy compounding

revenue_model.value: product sales: IV solutions, administration sets and consumable devices bought repeatedly, infusion pumps and hardware; service fees: software, support and maintenance for infusion systems

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: makes pumps, IV sets and IV solutions from purchased materials, sold to hospitals and health systems

geography_served.value: global: United States as largest market, plus Europe, Latin America, Asia Pacific and Middle East

specialization.value: related lines: infusion pumps and software, consumables, IV solutions and vascular access sold to the same hospital customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales force selling to hospitals, health systems and group purchasing contracts; distributors / dealers: medical distributors and international distributors

regulatory_exposure.value: high: medical devices and IV drugs needing FDA clearance or approval, EU MDR and other national regulators
